meaning:
σχέδον
adv. (ἔχω), [in LXX: 2Ma.5:2, 3Ma.5:14 3Mac 5:45 * ;]
1. of place, near.
2. Of degree, almost, nearly: Act.13:44 19:26, Heb.9:22.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: The next Sabbath, almost the whole city was gathered together to hear the word of God.
According to the law, nearly everything is cleansed with blood, and apart from shedding of blood there is no remission.
